# FG-DEPLOY-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_freeze_window_blocks_at_request_and_at_execution` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この環境は凍結期間中のため、デプロイできません。凍結期間が終わってからもう一度要求してください。
- en: This environment is in a freeze window, so it cannot be deployed. Request the deployment again after the freeze window ends.
- id: Lingkungan ini sedang dalam masa pembekuan, sehingga tidak dapat di-deploy. Minta deployment lagi setelah masa pembekuan berakhir.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 (ADR-0031 decision 7): `now()` (the database clock) is inside one of the environment's `freeze_windows`. Checked when a deployment is requested (the request is refused, nothing written) and again when the worker takes it (the deployment ends `blocked`, nothing ran on any target). There is no bypass for automation or administrators: change the freeze windows (DeployEnvironmentManage, audited) instead.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route logs the refusal with `error_code`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `environment`; the worker logs `forge.deploy.blocked` with `deployment_id`, `reason=frozen`. Read: SELECT tier, freeze_windows FROM forge.deploy_environments WHERE project_id = <id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Wait for the freeze window to end and request again, or (a Maintainer) shorten the window: PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/deploy/environments/{tier} with the new `freeze_windows`.
